title: Grandpa's Garden of Sayings
text: Every summer, Grandpa says his tomato plants are as tall as a house, even though they only reach his shoulder. He tells us the rain falls like tiny silver needles when a storm rolls in. Last week, Grandpa said it was raining cats and dogs, and I looked outside expecting to see animals falling from the sky. Instead, I saw only heavy rain pouring down on the garden, so hard it flooded the flower beds in minutes. Grandpa just laughed and grabbed two umbrellas so we could dash out to save his tomato plants. Now I listen closely whenever Grandpa compares things, because he always paints a colorful picture with his words.
comprehension_hint_topics: what raining cats and dogs really means
how Grandpa compares the tomato plants to a house
